macros.name: disablehandout
macros.doc: use \disablehandout to disable the handout’s generation from the current point and \enablehandout to enable it from the current point.

macros.name: enablehandout
macros.doc: use \disablehandout to disable the handout’s generation from the current point and \enablehandout to enable it from the current point.

macros.name: nothandout
macros.doc: the argument of a command \nothandout will be printed only in the main text.

macros.name: onlyhandout
macros.doc: The argument of a \onlyhandout command will be printed only in the handout.
